pkgmetadata.longdescription: The full Omarchy install in one command: the desktop core (app-misc/omarchy) plus the default application set upstream's ISO installs, mapped from upstream's omarchy-base.packages list onto ::gentoo and this overlay. Entries ::gentoo no longer ships, and Omarchy in-house tools not yet ported, are left out — the ebuild comments list every omission with its reason.
